turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the RBI regional monitoring cell, calling regarding your savings account KYC status.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: KYC? But I gave my documents to the branch manager last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, those files were not uploaded correctly in the new system and your account will be blocked by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh dear, please tell me what to do. I have my pension coming in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, I can fix it right now online. I just need to verify your identity first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, what do you need from me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please read out your sixteen digit debit card number and the expiry date.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this safe? I was told never to share card details over the phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a secure government line, Mrs. Banerjee. If you do not provide it, the twelve thousand rupees pending in your reward credit will also be forfeited.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? I didn't know about any reward, but please just block the account from closing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly. Now just tell me the card number and the OTP that arrives on your phone.
